# Zoella Balloons

> Luxury custom balloon designs, organic balloon garlands, and bespoke celebration backdrops based in Houston, Texas.

Zoella Balloons creates elevated, photo-ready balloon installations for milestone birthdays, luxury baby showers, bridal showers, weddings, and corporate brand activations throughout the Greater Houston area.

## Core Capabilities
- Custom Organic Balloon Garlands & Arches
- Architectural & Custom Cutout Backdrops
- Themed Party Installations (Pastel, Vibrant, Luxe Monochromatic, Neutral Boho)
- Corporate Brand Activations & Grand Openings
- On-Site Delivery, Setup, and Styling

## Geographic Service Area
Houston, Texas and surrounding communities including:
- River Oaks & Memorial
- The Heights & Montrose
- West University & Bellaire
- The Galleria / Uptown
- Katy & Sugar Land
- The Woodlands & Cypress
- Pearland & Clear Lake

## How to Book
1. Complete the booking enquiry generator on the website with your date, venue location, theme palette, and occasion.
2. Send the prepared specification directly via Instagram Direct Message to @zoellaballoons to confirm date availability and receive a formal custom quote.
